about.title: About & Privacy
about.body1: Kathaipoma is an anonymous women's health awareness and preliminary screening companion. It is not a hospital, and it does not diagnose disease.
about.body2: No login, no account, no password. We do not collect your name, phone number, or identity. Anonymous answers may be used only to improve Kathaipoma AI.
about.body3: No tracking cookies, no advertisements, no selling of data.
